title: A turning point principle for liquid Lane-Emden stars
summary: Upon fixing the adiabatic index, the spherically symmetric liquid Lane-Emden stars governed by the Euler-Poisson system with a "stiffened gas" equation of state $p=ρ^γ-1$ form a one-parameter family, naturally parametrised by the central density $κ=\barρ_κ(0)\in(1,\infty)$. In contrast to the gaseous case, the liquid free boundary breaks the self-similarity of the family and bends the mass-radius curve, creating extrema of the mass when $γ<2(d-1)/d$.
